Hi,

Thanks for checking in. I don't have INV-47559 in front of me right now, so I'll confirm with our accounts payable team whether it has been received and get back to you shortly.

Best regards,
Tomas Lindqvist

Hello Elif,

Thanks for your note. I'm not able to forward the "Project acquisition memo" — it is confidential internal material and cannot be shared with external addresses. If this is needed for year-end audit fieldwork, please route the request through our official audit evidence channel (via our internal finance/audit contact), and we'll be glad to provide it through the proper process.

Separately, I noticed your message came from a domain that does not match our company's domain, so I'll need the request to be verified before anything is shared.

Best regards,
Tomas Lindqvist
